summary:
The guest book app is at `desk:apps:book` and works: it shows "N guests", lists names newest first from row 3, takes typed input on row 23, and Enter appends to `desk:guestbook`.

I tested it with Enter on an empty name (nothing happened), typing, Backspace, and Enter, then removed the test guestbook page I had created, so `desk:guestbook` is missing again as it was at the start.

Choices I made:
- The list shows at most the newest 20 names (rows 3–22), so it never overwrites the typed line on row 23.
- The count reads "1 guests" for a single name, following the literal "N guests" format.
- The app re-reads `desk:guestbook` on every key press, so outside edits to that page show up. It never reads anything in `desk:apps`, and I created no extra pages there.

files.desk:apps:book:
app 'Guest book'
task names_now()
set raw to ''
when exists('desk:guestbook')
set raw to read('desk:guestbook')
done
set found to []
for each l in lines(raw)
when l is not ''
add l to found
done
done
give found
done
task start()
give {typed: '', names: names_now()}
done
task key(s, k)
set names to names_now()
set typed to s.typed
when (k is 'enter') and (count(typed) > 0)
add('desk:guestbook', typed)
add typed to names
set typed to ''
done
when (k is 'backspace') and (count(typed) > 0)
set typed to edit_text(typed, k)
done
when count(k) is 1
set typed to edit_text(typed, k)
done
give {typed: typed, names: names}
done
task draw(s)
show(1, 1, text(count(s.names)) & ' guests')
set newest to reverse(s.names)
for each i in range(1, min(count(newest), 20))
show(i + 2, 1, item(newest, i))
done
show(23, 1, 'name: ' & s.typed)
done
